evidence.reason: In render_units, templates are collected recursively from the pinned tree and output solely as output / source.name. Two distinct paths with the same basename (for example a top-level and a subdirectory crq-*.service) both enter templates but collide at the same target; the later atomic_bytes call overwrites the earlier rendered unit, and both paths are appended for later verification. There is no duplicate-basename rejection before writing. This is a minor correctness defect; unique basenames still work normally, and a small pre-write check can reject conflicts.
